title: 第7章 是冰种第8章 结交林北孙雪儿
slug: 分手后我聘上女同学妈妈小司机
content_zh:
“五十万？”摊主的脸瞬间垮了下来，眉头拧成一团，苦着脸说，“老板，您这价也太高了！”
“这糯种虽然不错，但体量小啊，五十万真的收不了。”
“您看这样，我再加十万，十五万，怎么样？”
“这已经是我的极限了！”
陈阳其实对翡翠的市场价确实不太了解，但也知道这块糯种翡翠绝不可能只值十五万。
他懒得跟摊主磨叽，摆了摆手：“你不要就拉倒。”
说完，转身就要继续往前走。
“等等！兄弟，五十万我要了！”一道急切的声音突然从身后传来。
陈阳回头一看，正是刚才那个富二代。
林北快步追了上来，脸上带着诚意十足的笑容，眼神紧紧盯着陈阳手里的石头，“兄弟，这石头五十万卖给我，怎么样？”
“你要是没问题，我现在就给你转账！”
陈阳上下打量了林北一眼，心里暗自思忖。
这人一看就是懂行的，愿意出五十万，说明这石头在他手上还能赚不少。
不过自己是外行，就算再找其他买家，也未必能卖出更高的价格，反而容易节外生枝。
他索性点了点头：“行，看你人还不错，就卖给你吧。”
“太好了！”林北喜出望外，连忙说，“你把账号给我，我现在就转钱。”
陈阳把石头递到一旁的孙雪儿手上。
小姑娘还愣在原地，抱着石头的样子像抱着个宝贝。
陈阳直接亮出手机上的银行卡相片。
林北拿出手机，飞快操作起来。

很快，陈阳的手机就传来了到账提示音。
看着手机屏幕上“500000元”的到账金额，陈阳的心脏忍不住狂跳了几下，心中大喜。
五千块买的石头，转眼就卖了五十万，这买卖做得也太爽了！
有了这笔钱，离一百万的目标又近了一大步。
林北接过孙雪儿递来的石头，小心翼翼地把玩着，脸上满是兴奋。
这糯种翡翠质地细腻，水头也不错，拿到他珠宝店加工成挂件，至少能翻个两三倍，稳赚不亏。
孙雪儿也凑在一旁，小脸上满是雀跃，刚才的懊悔早就抛到九霄云外了。
陈阳没理会两人的兴奋，目光突然扫到什么，眼睛微微一亮。
他转头看向林北，问：“你还收翡翠原石吗？”
“收啊，怎么不收！”林北连忙点头，眼神里带着期待，“兄弟，你还有好货？”
陈阳不置可否，只是点了点头，转身朝着最后一个摊位走去。
林北见状，连忙把石头递给身旁跟着的司机，低声吩咐道：“把这块石头先送回去，小心点。”
司机恭敬地应了声，捧着石头快步离开了。
林北则带着孙雪儿，紧紧跟在陈阳身后。
陈阳径直走到摊位前，指着一块足球大小的石头，对摊主问：“老板，这块石头什么价？”
这个摊主刚才也目睹到陈阳一刀切出糯种翡翠，一时直接就把陈阳当成了财神爷。
见陈阳主动问价，他立马热情地迎了上来，还顺手递上一杯温热的茶水，脸上的笑容都快溢出来了：“老板，您眼光真好！”
“这块可是我镇摊之石，从老坑口出来的，出货率高达百分之九十九！”
content_en:
"Half a million?" The stall owner's face suddenly fell, his brows knitted together, and he said with a grimace, "Boss, your price is too high!"
"Although this glutinous seed is good, it is small and cannot be harvested for half a million yuan."
"Look at this, how about if I add another 100,000 or 150,000?"
"This is my limit!"
Chen Yang actually didn't know much about the market price of jade, but he also knew that this piece of waxy jade could never be worth only 150,000 yuan.
He was too lazy to argue with the stall owner and waved his hand: "If you don't want to, I'll pull him down."
After saying that, he turned around and continued walking forward.
"Wait! Brother, I want half a million!" An urgent voice suddenly came from behind.
Chen Yang looked back and saw that it was the rich second generation just now.
Lin Bei quickly caught up with him, with a sincere smile on his face and his eyes fixed on the stone in Chen Yang's hand, "Brother, how about selling this stone to me for 500,000 yuan?"
"If you have no problem, I will transfer the money to you now!"
Chen Yang looked Lin Bei up and down, thinking to himself.
This man seems to know his stuff and is willing to pay half a million yuan, which shows that he can still make a lot of money from this stone.
However, I am an outsider, so even if I find other buyers, I may not be able to sell it at a higher price, but it will easily lead to extraneous problems.
He simply nodded: "Okay, since you're a nice person, I'll sell it to you."
"Great!" Lin Bei was overjoyed and said quickly, "Give me your account number and I will transfer the money now."
Chen Yang handed the stone to Sun Xueer's hand who was standing aside.
The little girl was still frozen in place, holding the stone as if she were holding a baby.
Chen Yang directly showed the bank card photo on his mobile phone.
Lin Bei took out his mobile phone and started operating it quickly.
Soon, Chen Yang's cell phone received a notification sound.
Looking at the amount of "500,000 yuan" on the screen of his mobile phone, Chen Yang couldn't help but his heart beat wildly, and he was overjoyed.
The stone bought for 5,000 yuan was sold for 500,000 yuan in a blink of an eye. This business was so exciting!
With this money, we are one step closer to our goal of one million.
Lin Bei took the stone from Sun Xueer and played with it carefully, his face full of excitement.
This waxy jade has a fine texture and a good water quality. If it is processed into a pendant in his jewelry store, it can be doubled or tripled in value, and you will definitely make a profit.
Sun Xueer also came to the side, her little face was full of joy, and the regret just now was long forgotten.
Chen Yang ignored the excitement of the two people. His eyes suddenly caught something and his eyes lit up slightly.
He turned to look at Lin Bei and asked, "Are you still collecting raw jade stones?"
"Take it, why don't you take it!" Lin Bei nodded quickly, with expectation in his eyes, "Brother, do you still have good goods?"
Chen Yang was noncommittal, just nodded, turned and walked towards the last stall.
Seeing this, Lin Bei quickly handed the stone to the driver who was following him, and whispered: "Send this stone back first, be careful."
The driver responded respectfully and left quickly holding the stone.
Lin Bei and Sun Xueer followed closely behind Chen Yang.
Chen Yang walked straight to the stall, pointed to a stone the size of a football, and asked the stall owner: "Boss, what is the price of this stone?"
The stall owner had just witnessed Chen Yang cutting out waxy jadeite with a single stroke, and he immediately regarded Chen Yang as the God of Wealth.
Seeing Chen Yang taking the initiative to inquire about the price, he immediately greeted him enthusiastically and handed him a cup of warm tea. The smile on his face almost overflowed: "Boss, you have such good taste!"
"This is my keystone. It comes from Laokengkou, and the shipment rate is as high as 99%!"
